title: Cross-domain ops and roadmap handoff - 2027-01-18
body:
Date: 2027-01-18
Time: 09:30–10:20 PT
Location: Zoom / hq-1 / recorded
Purpose: Weekly cross-team leadership sync focused on operational handoffs, short-term roadmap alignment, and current blockers affecting SLA/latency targets. This session emphasized clarifying ownership for Q1 surface-area handoffs between Platform, Serving Runtime, SRE, and Product.

Attendees:
- Elena Morales (owner, platform engineering)
- Marcus Lin (serving-runtime lead)
- Priya Desai (SRE)
- Jonah Rivera (product-hosted-api PM)
- Katerina Smirnov (solutions eng)
- Claire Ho (observability - guest)

Quick wins / updates (5m each):
- Platform: Completed migration of one internal staging pool to new autoscaler; 12% cost improvement on staging infra reported by FinOps. No user-facing impact.
- Serving Runtime: Kernel selection heuristics landed in canary; early runs show 9–12% token throughput uplift for 8k seq workloads. Need broader perf sweep.
- SRE: Incident triage for multi-region failover is in final playbook review; hoping to run game-day next week.
- Product: Hosted API rollout plan schedule moved to mid-Feb due to UX changes for streaming.

Agenda items and notes:
1) Handoff of model variant routing policy (10m)
- Context: Product wants per-customer routing policies to be enforceable at the platform layer to support Dedicated and Hosted parity.
- Decision: Platform will own the policy enforcement API surface; Serving Runtime will implement the runtime decision points (router shim) and SRE will validate SLA effects in staging.
- Follow-up: Marcus to add router-shim RFC to repo by 2027-01-22 (INF-4920). Priya to schedule a staging validation window 2027-01-25.

2) Latency SLO regressions observed on 95th p50->p95 shift (15m)
- Observed: Last 72h shows 95th increase from 320ms to 460ms on text-generation small models for short prompts (<=128 tokens).
- Investigation notes: Trace sampling indicates increased cold-KV-cache misses and slightly smaller batch sizes during peak due to recent autoscaler threshold tweak.
- Temp mitigation: Roll back autoscaler change for dedicated-pool-A (actioned during meeting).
- Action items: Priya (SRE) to lead post-mortem and propose autoscaler knob matrix by 2027-01-20 (PM: INF-4897). Marcus to run KV-cache warmup experiment in canary by 2027-01-21.

3) Private deployment packaging timeline (10m)
- Risk: Enterprise customer pilot requires a hardened on-prem install image with KMS integration and audit piping. Current delivery target is early March; legal wants Q1 commitments tightened.
- Decision: Move to a two-track delivery — core installer GA (no HSM) on 2027-02-28; HSM/KMS integration as an opt-in patch track by 2027-03-31.
- Owner: Elena to update the enterprise contract attachment; Jonah to rebase the pilot onboarding checklist by 2027-01-24.

4) Observability retention and cost tradeoffs (8m)
- Claire presented short analysis: 30-day retention of trace spans costs ~18% of observability budget. Reducing to 14 days for non-prod reduces cost 11% with minimal signal loss for regression detection.
- Decision: Implement tiered retention. Non-prod 14d, prod 30d; review in 6 weeks. Claire to open policy PR and onboarding doc (due 2027-01-26).

5) Roadmap pulse check and feature interlocks (10m)
- Q1 priorities reiteration: reliable Dedicated autoscaling, Hosted streaming UX improvements, Private deployment installer, and runtime quantization experiments.
- Interlocks: Product streaming change blocks Hosted GA; Serving Runtime quantization is dependent on compiler kernel updates from infra.
- Risk register update: Marked two high-risk items: streaming UX regression (owner Jonah) and quantization correctness tests (owner Marcus).

Open blockers / escalations (5m):
- Capacity: One shortage window flagged for west-2 GPUs 2027-02-02 to 2027-02-10 due to partner maintenance. Platform to coordinate capacity borrowing with sales for enterprise workloads. Owner: Elena.
- Compliance: SOC2 doc refresh requires additional audit evidence for Dedicated customers using customer-managed KMS. Security to track evidence collection. Owner: Katerina.

Action items (clear owners and due dates):
1. Marcus Lin: Create router-shim RFC in serve repo (INF-4920). Due 2027-01-22.
2. Priya Desai: Post-mortem for p95 latency regression and autoscaler knob matrix. Due 2027-01-20.
3. Marcus Lin: KV-cache warmup experiment in canary and results summary. Due 2027-01-21.
4. Elena Morales: Update enterprise contract attachment & coordinate capacity spill plan for west-2. Due 2027-01-21.
5. Jonah Rivera: Rebase pilot onboarding checklist for private deployment. Due 2027-01-24.
6. Claire Ho: Open observability retention policy PR and docs. Due 2027-01-26.
7. Katerina Smirnov: Compile SOC2 evidence list for Dedicated KMS customers; sync with Security. Due 2027-01-28.
8. Platform / SRE: Schedule game-day for multi-region failover. Owner: Priya. Target date 2027-01-25.

Notes / informal items captured:
- Several people flagged that the Hosted streaming UX delays are mostly due to server-side backpressure semantics not being surfaced in the SDK. Suggestion: short-term shim that exposes a stream state to the client for debugging.
- There was informal agreement to standardize on a single JSON structure for router policies to avoid translation layers. Marcus will sketch and share next meeting.
- Elena requested a short weekly kernel compatibility snapshot (1-page) from Serving Runtime to be added to the leadership digest. Marcus volunteered.

Decisions summary (for DM to GTM/legal):
- Platform enforces routing policy API, runtime implements decision point.
- Two-track private deployment delivery for KMS/HSM.
- Observability retention tiering for non-prod/prod.

Risks noted:
- Short-term capacity risk in west-2 (mitigated by spill plan).
- Quantization correctness could delay Dedicated perf wins if kernel updates are slower than expected.

Next meeting: 2027-01-25, 09:30 PT (short form: focus on PMRs from action items and game-day schedule).

Misc / links referenced inline: see linked_artifacts field for RFCs, JIRA tickets, PR links and confluence roadmap.

Meeting minutes prepared by: Elena Morales
Status: draft — please add comments inline or ping @elena on slack for urgent corrections.
